name: @wyverselabs/agentcraft
description: CLI for installing StarCraft sounds into Claude Code or Codex

scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:game-ui
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:cli && bun run typecheck:game-ui
scripts.dev:game: bun run build:game-ui && concurrently -k -n UI,CLI "AGENTCRAFT_GAME_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4320 vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --open" "bun --watch src/cli.ts game --ui phaser --port 4320"
scripts.dev:game:starcraft-local: bun run build:game-ui && concurrently -k -n UI,CLI "AGENTCRAFT_GAME_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4320 vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --open" "bun --watch src/cli.ts game --ui phaser --asset-pack starcraft-local --port 4320"
scripts.dev:game:watch: concurrently -k -n UI,CLI "vite build --watch" "bun --watch src/cli.ts game --ui phaser --port 4318 --open"
scripts.dev:game:starcraft-local:watch: concurrently -k -n UI,CLI "vite build --watch" "bun --watch src/cli.ts game --ui phaser --asset-pack starcraft-local --port 4318 --open"
scripts.assets:install:starcraft-local: bun src/cli.ts game assets install --pack starcraft-local --assets-dir assets/starcraft-local-from-clone
